page.marginRule: Equal on all four edges. One knob: --resume-page-margin. Never shrink it to fix overflow — move a section to the next page instead.

contentBox.rule: Each page's content must FIT this box. Overflow makes the pinned signature collide with the last lines.

pageModel.rule: Header flows at the top; footer/signature pins to the bottom. Print CSS must repeat the flex declaration and set overflow: hidden.

pagination.trap: A trailing break-after: page emits a phantom blank sheet.

bestFor: Every standard application document. This is the house page model — deviate only with a reason.
